title: The Bike Nerds Are Having a Wheelie Big Fight: Are 32-inch Wheels Actually Faster?
content:
Does a 32-inch wheel actually save watts, or is the testing methodology broken? We put Chung Method advocate John Karrasch and vocal critic Jan Heine in the same room to hash out the reality of rolling resistance.

Read the full article at The Bike Nerds Are Having a Wheelie Big Fight: Are 32-inch Wheels Actually Faster? on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
